units.source_text: 本回写薰君十四五岁至二十三岁秋天之事，

en.t: This chapter describes events in Lord Kaoru's life from the age of fourteen or fifteen to the autumn of his twenty-third year,

units.source_text: 与前二回《匂皇子》《红梅》系同一时期。

en.t: and it takes place in the same period as the preceding two chapters, "The Fragrant Prince" and "The Red Plum."
